measurementInterpretation.localAdmission: Exact request-ID server headers-received clock to host-owned command entry, including body decode, correlation and compact terminal fence; before durable application.
measurementInterpretation.clientClock: Separate same-request duration from public client call through handshake and application reply. The native HTTP API profile has no CLI/MCP child startup; child functional tests are separate.
measurementInterpretation.provider: Settlement is excluded from the admission clock and independently exercised with held executor observation and exact stop/abandonment/claim-release cuts.
measurementInterpretation.sharedLoad: No causal shared-load attribution is established or used to waive the target.
measurementInterpretation.quantum: 10 ms is an unmeasured provisional reference, not a hard real-time claim.

review.result: No reasonable blocking findings; subsequent source change is two TypeScript bracket accesses in the profile test.
